decision.reason: [ev-61d6d2b50a95] is just the list item "- app" under the heading "`service_name` label" in the upgrade guide. On its own it does not say what changed for "app" (added, removed or changed, and what it was before and after), which environments are exposed, or what happens if the operator does nothing. We need the surrounding paragraph that this list belongs to, which explains how the service_name label relates to labels like "app".
